[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Two passenger indexes list Mary Glasgow, age zero, aboard the Bride from Plymouth to Melbourne in May 1853. One gives the arrival as 17 May. The nationality fields differ.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1635/records/3724290 Ancestry, Victoria, Australia, Assisted and Unassisted Passenger Lists, 1839-1923: Mary Glasgow, record 1635/3724290].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/1635/records/2638163 Ancestry, Victoria, Australia, Assisted and Unassisted Passenger Lists, 1839-1923: Mary Glasgow, record 1635/2638163].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The two indexes agree on name, age and voyage. Neither establishes her parents or wider identity.

Identity resolution, 16 November 2026: no existing catalogue profile matched this record. The record defines a distinct documentary person; later life and any relationships beyond those stated in the record remain unresolved. The sourced draft is creation-ready with those limits.

== Biography ==
Two Southern Cemetery indexes list Frances Glasgow, age 79, with death on 29 May 1932 in Otago. One gives birth on 14 February 1853 and the other gives burial on 1 June 1932.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60547/records/1681100 Ancestry, New Zealand, Cemetery Records, 1800-2007: Frances Glasgow, record 60547/1681100].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/60547/records/201070 Ancestry, New Zealand, Cemetery Records, 1800-2007: Frances Glasgow, record 60547/201070].</ref>

== Research Notes ==
The records agree on the cemetery, name, age and death date. Her wider identity remains unresolved.
